result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B keeps lilac as the main surface color and runs the gradient as a bold vertical 'floor stripe' through the hero. Its sessions become a schedule board instead of icon cards, so it feels like a rink and the brand colors lead. A's centre-line stripe with the circle is a lovely rink touch, but its near-black hero leaves the gradient and lilac as trim. B moves the address into the hero, which slightly changes the original order. Only the top of each page was visible in the screenshots, so the lower sections were not checked. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A makes lilac the main surface and paints the purple-to-pink gradient down the middle of a rink-shaped hero, which ties the page to the real floor and keeps the brand colors in charge. B has a strong marquee-sign feel, but most of the page is dark navy, so lilac and the gradient are mostly borders, buttons and a divider. Both keep the original content without adding prices or claims, though A also puts the address in the hero.
